speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Your wife is concerned about your recent bizarre and agitated behavior; can you tell me exactly what happened and when these symptoms started?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old male. The patient has been demonstrating bizarre and agitated behavior for the past 6 weeks. He believes that he is being spied on by the NSA which is also controlling his mind. Since his unemployment, he has been focused on creating a device to prevent people from controlling his mind.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Paranoid Schizophrenia

The patient presents with a 6-week history of persecutory delusions (being spied on by the NSA, mind control) and bizarre behavior, alongside a 3-month history of social withdrawal and depressed mood.
